title: Huerta Group LLC — Capability and Dependency Registry Schema
description: Validates knowledge/capability-registry.json — the machine-readable representation of the institutional capability and system map (institution/technical/internal-software-architecture.md). Registry entries describe architecture; they authorize no construction and create no institutional authority. Unresolved values are recorded transparently, never guessed.

category.description: Coarse grouping for reading the map; carries no authority.

maturity.description: Current maturity state (Development Transition Assessment vocabulary). Public copy never counts as implementation.

architecturalDisposition.description: Where the capability runs (or would run). 'unresolved' is a first-class honest value; a disposition never implies implementation authorization.

repositoryDisposition.description: Where the capability's code/artifacts live (or would). Decided by the ADR-0003 criteria, never by convenience.

dataOwned.description: Data categories this capability authoritatively owns (architectural ownership, not legal doctrine).

dataConsumed.description: Data categories consumed from their owning capability.

dependsOn.description: Upstream capability ids. Downstream dependents are derived, never duplicated.

identityRequirement.description: Whether the capability requires authenticated identity. All values are technical; none is an institutional office.

sensitivity.description: Highest sensitivity of data the capability would handle.

launchRelevance.description: Relationship to the owner-gated official launch.

implementationReadiness.description: Understood technology never suffices for 'ready'; inputs and authority must exist.

evidencePaths.description: Repository paths that must exist when maturity is operational/partial/standby — mechanically checked by the validator.

governingReferences.description: Repository-relative paths of governing/architecture documents that inform this entry. Paths must exist.

unresolvedDecisions.description: Open institutional or architectural questions, stated plainly. Required (may be empty only when genuinely nothing is open).

dataCategory.description: Architectural data-ownership categories (see the data-ownership model in the architecture foundation). Names describe system responsibility, not legal ownership, rights, retention, or disclosure policy.
